pool.text: Juan Rejón established the settlement known then as Real de Las Palmas.
Pedro de Vera incorporated the island into the Crown of Castile.
The diocese was transferred from Lanzarote to Real de Las Palmas.
Christopher Columbus anchored his ship Pinta in the port for repairs.
Francis Drake attempted to plunder the town during a naval conflict.
Pieter van der Does led a Dutch raid that destroyed parts of the town.
Basílica de Nuestra Señora del Pino was established in Teror.
Nicolás Estévanez was born as a military officer, politician and poet.
The Province of Canary Islands was split into Santa Cruz de Tenerife and Las Palmas.
A set of 37 caves named Cueva de Los Frailes was discovered.
A museum dedicated to Néstor Martín-Fernández de la Torre opened.
The port benefited greatly from the closure of the Suez Canal.
Javier Bardem was born as a notable Spanish actor.
The archaeological site of El Tope was discovered with aboriginal artifacts.
The Atlantic Center of Modern Art opened as a major cultural reference.
A transport company formed resulting from the merger of Salcai and Utinsa.
Spanish Ministry of Development put out a contract for a railway feasibility study.
The Teatro Pérez Galdós reopened following extensive renovation works.
The airport handled over ten million passengers and massive cargo amounts.
The Guiniguada Theater prepared to reopen after a decade long refurbishment.
